title: El-cheep-o Miniprep
author: Magdalena M Julkowska
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.peudjew

steps.title: Pellet cells by centrifugation
steps.instruction: Spin 3 ml of the overnight culture (or 1.5 ml for time) at 13 000 rpm for 5 min to pellet the cells.

steps.title: Resuspend cells with P1/RNase
steps.instruction: Add 250 ml of sol P1+RNase 5 ml and vortex to resuspend the cells.

steps.title: Add solution P2
steps.instruction: Add 250 ml of sol P2 and mix gently.

steps.title: Add solution P3
steps.instruction: Add 350 ml of sol P3 and mix gently.

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with isopropanol
steps.instruction: Take 750 ml of the supernatant, transfer it to a new Eppendorf tube, and add 750 ml of isopropanol.

substeps.instruction: Transfer 750 ml of supernatant to a new Eppendorf tube.
Add 750 ml of isopropanol to the tube.
